description: This file defines a PHP trait 'HasDataTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP. The trait provides methods to handle data stored in an array, implementing interfaces such as ToArray, ArrayAccess, Countable, and IteratorAggregate, enabling objects to behave like arrays.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing the internal data array.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value at the specified offset, allowing for indirect modification.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value at the specified offset in the data array.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists in the data array.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Unsets the value at the specified offset.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the data array.
